findings.description: The agent must NOT assert that Patrick Hoban (PID KK3W-WLT, b. 1836, Halifax, Nova Scotia) had a wife named Ellen, or a son Thomas Dee who married Bessie Butler at Halifax in 1895. The hinted 1895 marriage names the groom's parents only by the bare forenames 'Patrick' and 'Ellen', with the groom carrying the surname Dee — not Hoban/Hobin. That groom's own birth record identifies him as Thomas A. Dee, born 8 October 1874 at Halifax to Patrick Dee and Ellen Callahan, a distinct Halifax family. Patrick Hoban's documented wife is Catherine Donovan (married 18 November 1867), and his son Thomas Patrick Hobin was born 11 February 1873, not 1874, and never carried the surname Dee. Pass = tree.gedcomx.json adds no wife named Ellen for Patrick Hoban, no son Thomas Dee, and no 1895 Dee marriage fact tied to him. An explicitly rejected candidate belongs in the research log (research.json), NOT in the tree: the avoid guard force-fails on presence in the final tree however the person is annotated, so writing the rejected candidate into the tree scores a miss.
